correctness.rationale: The graph ideal is obtained by exact elimination from the monomial parametrization. The first projection is an isomorphism away from the two base points. Exact affine-chart reductions over the two exceptional fibers give the hypersurface germs X^3-AY and XB-Z^2 and two complementary affine-plane charts; their critical ideals isolate exactly one point each. This proves the singular locus and the A2/A1 classification.

value.rationale: The source uses Example 6.6 as a canonical nonlinear-multiview test case but records only its multidegrees. Determining that its graph is a normal toric surface with exactly one A2 and one A1 rational double point gives structural birational information useful for resolutions and intersection theory, rather than a routine recomputation of the published mixed-volume numbers.
